An exceptional opportunity has become available for a dedicated VR General Practitioner to join a well-established, long-standing community practice located in the highly sought-after suburb of Kenmore, Queensland. Operating as a high-demand, mixed-billing clinic, the practice provides comprehensive healthcare to patients of all ages within a welcoming and professional environment. The incoming practitioner will step into an established patient base, ensuring immediate clinical volume and excellent earning potential with a highly competitive offering of 75% of billings. 

 The modern medical facility is fully equipped to support a wide range of clinical preferences, featuring onsite pathology collection and utilizing leading clinical software such as Best Practice and MedicalDirector. The practice environment is defined by a supportive, collaborative team culture where practitioners enjoy full clinical autonomy. General practitioners are backed by an experienced nursing team and a dedicated reception and administrative staff, allowing them to focus entirely on patient care. Robust support is provided for chronic disease management (CDM), care plans, multidisciplinary care, preventive health, and comprehensive health assessments. 

 The clinic serves a diverse demographic, offering substantial scope for special interest opportunities. Practitioners can easily integrate services such as women’s and men’s health, mental health care, minor procedures, iron infusions, and Implanon insertions and removals into their daily practice. Additionally, the practice fosters professional growth by offering continuous professional development (CPD) support and rewarding supervisor opportunities for those interested in mentoring the next generation of medical professionals. 

 Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, the practice offers highly flexible working arrangements with both full-time and part-time positions available to suit individual lifestyles. Situated in the leafy, family-friendly western suburbs of Brisbane, the Kenmore location delivers outstanding lifestyle benefits. It boasts excellent local schools, beautiful green spaces, and vibrant cafe districts, all while remaining conveniently close to the Brisbane CBD. Registered Nurse (Part Time)  

  Valley View Medical Lithgow  

 An exciting opportunity to join a new medical practice and make a meaningful impact on patient care in the Lithgow community. 

 Valley View Medical Lithgow is a new general practice committed to providing high-quality, patient-centred healthcare in a welcoming and supportive environment. We are seeking an experienced and motivated Registered Nurse to join our team on either a full-time or part-time basis. 

 This is an excellent opportunity to be involved in establishing a new practice and play an integral role in supporting both our patients and clinical team. 

  Key Responsibilities  

 
	 
	 Provide high-quality nursing care and support to patients within the practice. 
	 
	 
	 Assist GPs with clinical procedures and patient assessments. 
	 
	 
	 Conduct health assessments, care plans, health checks, and chronic disease management activities. 
	 
	 
	 Administer vaccinations and maintain cold chain management protocols. 
	 
	 
	 Perform wound care, ECGs, spirometry, and other clinical nursing duties as required. 
	 
	 
	 Support infection prevention and control processes. 
	 
	 
	 Maintain accurate clinical documentation and patient records. 
	 
	 
	 Participate in quality improvement activities and support RACGP Accreditation requirements. 
	 
	 
	 Manage clinical stock, equipment maintenance, and treatment room organisation. 
	 
	 
	 Promote preventative health initiatives and patient education. 
	 
 

  What We're Looking For  

 
	 
	 Current registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (AHPRA) as a Registered Nurse. 
	 
	 
	 5+ years proven experience working in General Practice. 
	 
	 
	 Experience with Chronic Disease Management, Health Assessments, Immunisations, and Care Plans. 
	 
	 
	 Knowledge of Medicare item numbers and Practice Incentive Program (PIP) activities desirable. 
	 
	 
	 Experience using Medical Director or similar will be highly regarded. 
	 
	 
	 Understanding of RACGP Accreditation standards and quality improvement activities. 
	 
	 
	 Current immunisation certification (or willingness to obtain). 
	 
	 
	 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
	 
	 
	 Strong organisational skills with the ability to work independently and collaboratively. 
	 
	 
	 A compassionate, patient-focused approach to care. 
	 
	 
	 Current CPR certificate and Working With Children Check (or willingness to obtain). 
	 
 

  Why Join Valley View Medical?  

 
	 
	 Be part of an exciting new practice from the ground up. 
	 
	 
	 Work in a supportive and collaborative team environment. 
	 
	 
	 Opportunity to contribute to the development of systems, processes, and patient programs. 
	 
	 
	 Flexible part-time hours to support work-life balance. 
	 
	 
	 Modern practice focused on delivering outstanding patient care. 
	 
	 
	 Competitive remuneration based on skills and experience.

result.description: Savic Motorcycles Limited   About the Role   We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design, develop, validate and improve the mechanical systems, components and manufacturing processes of the Savic C-Series electric motorcycle platform. This is an engineering role covering the full product lifecycle, from concept design through to production readiness, with genuine ownership of components and systems on a market-leading Australian-designed electric motorcycle.   Key Responsibilities    Design, develop and optimise mechanical components, assemblies and vehicle systems for the Savic C-Series platform and upcoming models, including chassis, suspension, bodywork, mounting systems and structural components.  Translate performance, durability, safety and manufacturing requirements into engineering specifications, drawings, tolerances and technical documentation.  Develop manufacturing-ready designs using Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles, GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis and material selection.  Perform and support engineering analysis including finite element analysis, fatigue analysis and topology optimisation, and develop and execute mechanical test plans and validation procedures.  Support the transition of designs from prototype to repeatable, production-ready manufacture, including release of manufacturing drawings, work instructions and inspection requirements.  Design or support the development of jigs, fixtures, gauges and other production aids to improve quality, safety and repeatability.  Maintain Engineering Change Management records, Bills of Materials, drawing releases and New Product Introduction documentation, including DFMEA, PFMEA and PPAP activities.  Lead FRACAS Meetings focusing on analysis, quality assurance and continuous improvement functions of mechanical components, in alignment with the software, systems and electrical engineering teams.    Support structured root-cause analysis and corrective action processes and maintain fault and corrective action records in Notion or other nominated engineering systems.  Identify opportunities to improve cost, manufacturability, weight and performance of components and assemblies, and evaluate alternative materials and manufacturing methods.  Work closely with Electrical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, Quality and Aftersales teams to ensure mechanical systems integrate effectively with the wider vehicle platform.    What We're Looking For    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  Demonstrated experience designing, developing and validating mechanical components, assemblies or systems in an automotive, motorcycle, EV, manufacturing, aerospace, robotics or related product-development environment.  Strong capability in mechanical design for manufacture, including GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, materials selection, manufacturing drawings and production documentation.  Experience with engineering analysis and validation methods, including FEA, fatigue assessment, physical testing, data acquisition or structured test planning.  Experience applying engineering quality and risk-management methods such as DFMEA, PFMEA, 8D, 5D, DMAIC, DFSS, PPAP or equivalent.  Experience supporting engineering change management, BOM control, drawing release and New Product Introduction processes.  Strong practical understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling, jigs, fixtures, machining, casting, fabrication or assembly methods.  Proficient with CAD, PLM/PDM, project management, engineering documentation and issue-tracking systems; experience with Notion, Jira, Odoo or equivalent systems is highly regarded.    Our Brand   In this role, you will act in accordance with our brand values and help us deliver our brand vision: to make EV riding enjoyable to every rider in the world.   We put people first — our customers are at the heart of what we do.  We design in Australia — being an Aussie brand is in our DNA.  We make informed decisions — using data, insights and experience.  We actually care — each person is personally passionate about what we're doing.      About Company      Savic Motorcycles is redefining the electric motorcycle industry with premium, high-performance machines that blend cutting-edge technology, sleek design and an exclusive brand experience. Our Engineering team is responsible for ensuring Savic motorcycles are safe, reliable, manufacturable, commercially viable, and continuously improving as the business scales.
